title: Orca 3D character animation update before 2026!
author: Soft_Negotiation3487
selftext:
Happy NYE to vibe game devs :) Very glad to have started working on an ai game engine, Orca this year along with my cracked ML engineer buddy to make our dream games come to life. As we enter 2026, I'm looking forward to sharing our dream with more of you.

To start 2026 well, we are releasing 3D model animation. You can generate textured 3d models, animate them, and play. (currently only available for bipedals)

LMK what game you're making, and what's hard about making it today.

replies.author: Soft_Negotiation3487
replies.body: [orcaengine.ai](http://orcaengine.ai) ! feel free to join the discord server as well :)

comments.author: Zennity
comments.body: Generated 3d models? Does it have a reasonable amount of faces from generation alone or is retopology required?

replies.author: Soft_Negotiation3487
replies.body: we retopologise, lower the poly, and make it game ready/rigged/textured when you generate on us, and you can drag drop into the scene, or just prompt it :)

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: So funny how they T-pose like that.

replies.author: Soft_Negotiation3487
replies.body: hahah ye, T pose is the default, you can also add idle animation for the models and default to that :)

comments.author: ArcyRC
comments.body: Really cool, I'll give it a try later. Been really disappointed with Meshy lately for my model making.

comments.author: Hanzyusuf
comments.body: Is there a chance that this will be made open source ? Would love to contribute as a developer for experience and fun !

replies.author: Soft_Negotiation3487
replies.body: not planning to make the engine OS, but we're thinking of allowing users to publish their games as OS so it can be modded easily!
